timing.packetHashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lowercase ffprobe SHA256:<payload hash> values in video-packet order, each followed by LF; timestamps and mux metadata excluded
timing.deltaMeaning: Last encoded packet PTS minus first PTS, minus native receipt wall duration. This excludes final frame duration; neither value is presented FPS.

limitations: Encoded packet PTS and decoded frame PTS belong to the recording, not monitor presentation or application FPS.

ReserveGuard covers this bounded local writer; it is not an OS quota and cannot stop unrelated applications, cloud tasks or processes that did not load the rule.
